description: One call across the whole corpus: incident clusters, entity profiles (actors, malware, vendors, CVEs) and dark-web ransomware listings that match the query. Costs 5 credits for the phrase; if that returns little it retries one call per word (up to 4 more, so 25 at worst) and `matched_stage` says which stage the results came from. Prefer search_threats (1 credit per term) when you only need clusters; use this when you do not know whether the name is an actor, a victim or a product, or when you want the dark-web hits too.

days.description: only results with activity in the last N days (free keys: up to 7)

limit.description: max clusters (entities and dark-web hits are capped the same way)

name: search_everything
title: Search clusters, entities and the dark web
